status: SOURCE-MODEL PREDICTIONS FROM EMBEDDED PROTOCOLS; NOT MEASURED OR CALIBRATED
axes_and_units: logical x=read, y=phase, z=slice; s/mm^2; columns bxx byy bzz bxy bxz byz
notes: b in s/mm^2; directions are unit vectors in logical read/phase/slice (x/y/z) from acq_x/y/z.
Echo 1 via eb.effective_b(pe_order=1); echoes >1 via eb._model with the echo index; nav_on=2 echo ETL+1 is the unencoded navigator echo.
Imaging view count passed to the model is the true N (raw views minus volume navigator); passing the raw count makes the model fail and silently fall back to nominal.

The model represents the first imaging shot; shot-dependent phase-encode terms vary within a volume and are not averaged. Effective b is identical for all slices (offsets change frequency/phase only).
model_b10_same_direction is an extra (hypothetical b=10 volume along the direction of each b>10 volume).

epi_nominal_stejskal_tanner.note: Nominal Stejskal-Tanner reference only: b = (gamma*G*delta)^2*(Delta - delta/3) with delta=4 ms, Delta=30 ms, rectangular lobes, b taken as typed. Implied G is the amplitude that formula needs. NOT MODELLED: the 200 us diffusion ramps, the EPI imaging-gradient (readout/phase-blip) cross terms with the diffusion lobes, and the slice-select/crusher terms, so the true EPI b-matrix is larger and has off-diagonal terms. The console btable.txt lists direction +x for every step (no_diff_dir=1), whereas the embedded diff_grad_dir array lists x/y/z per step; which one the EPI PPL actually plays is not resolved here (EPI PPL is not in the repository).
